full_judgment: 2. The case of the appellants, in brief, is that the predecessors of the appellants filed Miscellaneous Case No. 57 of 1981 under Section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 in the Court of Subordinate Judge, Patiya, Chittagong, praying for pre-emption of the case land. Subsequently, the said case was transferred to the Court of Munsif, Anowara, Chittagong and was renumbered as Miscellaneous Case No. 38 of 1983. That One Abeda Khatun was the original recorded tenant of the case land who used to cultivate the ame through bargader and the petitioner is a contiguous land owner of the south plots of the case schedule land and on 04.10.1981, the petitioner found that respondent No. 1 inspecting the schedule land and inquiring about the boundary thereof from bargader and on query the bargader with much hesitation disclosed that the respondent No. 1-3 purchased the same and thereafter the petitioner made search in Anowara Sub-registry Office to find out the kabala but failed to locate it and thereafter ultimately located the same in the District Registrar Office, Chittagong and got the certified copy of the sale deed dated 05.05.1980 and 29.10.1981 and the petitioner alleged that the vendor and vendee collusively created it in the District Registrar Office to keep secrecy to avoid pre-emption and no local person has been cited as witness of the deed to maintain secrecy and that no notice of sale was given to the petitioner.
